content.thinking: All protocol tests in group 1 pass. Now let me test preflight/whitelist, CLOSE, and idle behaviors.

arguments.command:
cat > /app/tmp/t/test_proto2.py <<'PYEOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/app/tmp/t")
from harness import *

ok = True

# ---- preflight: empty frames / UNKNOWN / whitelist
ok &= check("no frames", CFG(), [dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"error","FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",0,None)],
        conn_closed("FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",0,src(0,0,None)), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("unknown frame", CFG(), [dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[PAD(),UNK(),UNK()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"error","FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",0,1)],
        conn_closed("FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",0,src(0,0,1)), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# forbidden frame before UNKNOWN -> PROTOCOL_VIOLATION at first forbidden
ok &= check("forbidden before unknown", CFG(), [dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[HD(),UNK()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"error","PROTOCOL_VIOLATION",0,0)],
        conn_closed("PROTOCOL_VIOLATION",0,src(0,0,0)), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# unknown before forbidden -> FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR
ok &= check("unknown before forbidden", CFG(), [dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[UNK(),HD()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"error","FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",0,0)],
        conn_closed("FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",0,src(0,0,0)), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# whitelist per level
for lvl, fr, name in [
    ("I", HD(), "HANDSHAKE_DONE in I"),
    ("H", HD(), "HANDSHAKE_DONE in H"),
    ("Z", HD(), "HANDSHAKE_DONE in Z"),
    ("A", HD(), "HANDSHAKE_DONE in A"),
    ("I", ACK([0,1]), "ACK in I ok"),
    ("H", ACK([0,1]), "ACK in H ok"),
    ("A", ACK([0,1]), "ACK in A ok"),
    ("I", STR(0,0,"",False), "STREAM in I"),
    ("H", STR(0,0,"",False), "STREAM in H"),
    ("I", RST(0,0), "RESET in I"),
    ("I", STOP(0), "STOP in I"),
    ("Z", ACK([0,1]), "ACK in Z"),
    ("Z", CRY(0,""), "CRYPTO in Z"),
]:
    if "ok" in name:
        continue
    ok &= check(name, CFG(early=True), [key(0,"A","install") if lvl=="A" else tick(0), dg(1,1200,[pkt(lvl,0,True,[fr])])],
        RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","PROTOCOL_VIOLATION",1,0)],
            conn_closed("PROTOCOL_VIOLATION",1,src(1,0,0)),
            KEYS(a="live") if lvl=="A" else KEYS(z="live" if lvl=="Z" else KEYS()),
            0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# CLOSE app=false allowed everywhere; app=true only Z/A
ok &= check("CLOSE app=false in I", CFG(), [dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[CLOSE(False,7)])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",0)],
        conn_closed("PEER_TRANSPORT_CLOSE",0,src(0,0,0),0,7), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("CLOSE app=true in I forbidden", CFG(), [dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[CLOSE(True,7)])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"error","PROTOCOL_VIOLATION",0,0)],
        conn_closed("PROTOCOL_VIOLATION",0,src(0,0,0)), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("CLOSE app=true in Z ok", CFG(early=True), [dg(0,1200,[pkt("Z",0,True,[CLOSE(True,9)])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",0)],
        conn_closed("PEER_APPLICATION_CLOSE",0,src(0,0,0),0,9), KEYS(z="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("CLOSE app=true in A ok", CFG(), [key(0,"A","install"),dg(1,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[CLOSE(True,9)])])],
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)],
        conn_closed("PEER_APPLICATION_CLOSE",1,src(1,0,0),1,9), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# CLOSE: commit earlier frames, ignore later semantics, but preflight later frames
ok &= check("CLOSE commits earlier", CFG(), [key(0,"A","install"),
        dg(1,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[STR(0,0,"6162",False),CLOSE(False,3),STR(0,2,"6364",True)] )])],
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)],
        conn_closed("PEER_TRANSPORT_CLOSE",1,src(1,0,1),1,3), KEYS(a="live"), 2,
        [st(0,2,None,False,False,"6162")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# later frame after CLOSE that would be forbidden -> still preflight error
ok &= check("CLOSE later forbidden preflight", CFG(), [key(0,"A","install"),
        dg(1,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[CLOSE(False,3),HD()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","PROTOCOL_VIOLATION",1,1)],
        conn_closed("PROTOCOL_VIOLATION",1,src(1,0,1)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# earlier semantic error wins over CLOSE
ok &= check("error before CLOSE wins", CFG(), [key(0,"A","install"),
        dg(1,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[STR(0,0,"6162",True),RST(0,1),CLOSE(False,3)])])],
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","FINAL_SIZE_ERROR",1,1)],
        conn_closed("FINAL_SIZE_ERROR",1,src(1,0,1)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# CLOSE then subsequent packets CONNECTION_CLOSED; pending dropped at termination
ok &= check("CLOSE drops pending", CFG(buffer_packets=4), [
        dg(0,1200,[pkt("H",0,True,[PAD()])]),
        key(1,"A","install"),
        dg(2,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[CLOSE(True,5)]),pkt("A",1,True,[PAD()]),pkt("H",1,True,[PAD()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"dropped","CONNECTION_CLOSED",2),pres(2,0,"accepted","OK",2),
             pres(2,1,"dropped","CONNECTION_CLOSED",2),pres(2,2,"dropped","CONNECTION_CLOSED",2)],
        conn_closed("PEER_APPLICATION_CLOSE",2,src(2,0,0),2,5), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# key events after termination are ignored (keys frozen)
ok &= check("key ignored after close", CFG(), [
        dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[CLOSE(False,1)])]),
        key(1,"H","install"), key(2,"H","discard"),
        dg(3,1200,[pkt("H",0,True,[PAD()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",0),pres(3,0,"dropped","CONNECTION_CLOSED",3)],
        conn_closed("PEER_TRANSPORT_CLOSE",0,src(0,0,0),0,1), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# layout check skipped when connection closed
ok &= check("layout skipped when closed", CFG(), [
        dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[CLOSE(False,1)])]),
        dg(1,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[PAD()]),pkt("I",1,True,[PAD()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",0),pres(1,0,"dropped","CONNECTION_CLOSED",1),pres(1,1,"dropped","CONNECTION_CLOSED",1)],
        conn_closed("PEER_TRANSPORT_CLOSE",0,src(0,0,0),0,1), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))

# ---- idle timer
ok &= check("idle at exact deadline", CFG(idle_ms=10), [tick(10)],
    RES("t",[], conn_idle(10, src(0)), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("idle after deadline", CFG(idle_ms=10), [tick(50)],
    RES("t",[], conn_idle(10, src(0)), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("idle disabled", CFG(idle_ms=0), [tick(1000000000000)],
    RES("t",[], conn_open(), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("idle before deadline", CFG(idle_ms=10), [tick(9)],
    RES("t",[], conn_open(), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# activity pushes the deadline
ok &= check("idle after activity", CFG(idle_ms=10), [dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[PAD()])]),tick(9),tick(10)],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",0)], conn_idle(10, src(2), 0), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# idle at a datagram event: packets dropped CONNECTION_CLOSED at event time, pending at deadline
ok &= check("idle at datagram", CFG(idle_ms=10, buffer_packets=4), [
        dg(0,1200,[pkt("H",0,True,[PAD()])]),
        dg(15,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[PAD()]),pkt("A",0,True,[PAD()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"dropped","CONNECTION_CLOSED",10),pres(1,0,"dropped","CONNECTION_CLOSED",15),pres(1,1,"dropped","CONNECTION_CLOSED",15)],
        conn_idle(10, src(1)), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# idle at key event: key ignored
ok &= check("idle at key event", CFG(idle_ms=10), [tick(10),key(11,"H","install")],
    RES("t",[], conn_idle(10, src(0)), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# no idle at EOF
ok &= check("no idle at EOF", CFG(idle_ms=10), [dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[PAD()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",0)], conn_open(0), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# idle only once; subsequent events no further idle checks
ok &= check("idle once", CFG(idle_ms=10), [tick(10),tick(20),dg(30,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[PAD()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(2,0,"dropped","CONNECTION_CLOSED",30)], conn_idle(10, src(0)), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# idle fires at first event when last_activity=0 and t>=idle
ok &= check("idle first event", CFG(idle_ms=5), [dg(5,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[PAD()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"dropped","CONNECTION_CLOSED",5)], conn_idle(5, src(0)), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))

print("ALL PASS" if ok else "SOME FAILED")
PYEOF
cd /app/tmp/t && python3 test_proto2.py 2>&1 | grep -E "FAIL|ALL PASS|SOME FAILED" -A2
